row: WOOF! Wellness Center is located in Southern Utah and was founded in 2014, by owners Anita and Ron DeLelles.  Anita is a licensed and certified massage therapist with training for humans, small animals and equine massage. WOOF! Wellness Center was created to serve health-conscious pet-guardians and their pets by providing Hydro Treadmill Therapy, AcuMassage and Cold Laser Treatment, along with other holistic-based services and health supplements.
